mechanism: Medroxyprogesterone may increase nifedipine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing nifedipine efficacy; additionally, nifedipine may inhibit medroxyprogesterone metabolism, increasing progestin levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and consider nifedipine dose adjustment; counsel on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy if medroxyprogesterone is used for contraception.
